title: SPA
text:
← Back to PSD Data menu
  











Current System

Access HEAD

Location: Front-ends are at A:drivesPIC PSD MonkSeal
Back-end is at \\picqueenfish_be.accdb
What each file does
SPA: The main SPA front end. Used to enter and view data
SPA - Error Checks: Used to run error checks while at IRC. It makes a local copy of the data and runs checks on them to make the process faster
SPA_export: Used to run ASCII exports from SPA to work with SAS programs
SPA_Queries: Used to run and save queries on an copy of the SPA data (backend is at \picqueenfish_Queries_be.accdb)
SPA_read-only: A read only copy of SPA used by Liz once in a while
SPA - Mobile: Don’t think it is being used anymore. Used to sync with read only and very limited phone version of SPA
SPA_export_field_camps: Don’t think it is being used anymore. Export for field camps to export their data
Users:
For NWHI: An island specific copy of SPA is made for each island when they go out in the field, which is then imported into the master database (at IRC) when the data returns. Brenda lets Vikram know when a dataset is ready to import and Vikram runs the import process. The data system is accessible from multiple laptops in the islands if the field campers requested P2P networking of the laptops
At IRC, the database is stored on a shared windows drive and the front-ends are stored on each users computer to access the data
The islands we deploy to can vary every year from these one: FFS, LAY, LIS, PHR, KUR, Midway (MDY). We also visit Nihoa-Mokumanamana and Niihau sometimes
For MHI: The data is entered into SPA_MHI or imported from island/partner specific google sheets using import programs stored on and run from PICV026. The MHI programs are at A:drivesPIC PSD MonkSeal
The import programs rely on a Devart ODBC driver for Google Sheets

← Back to PSD Data menu
  











Current System

Access

Location:
Front-ends at: A:drivesPIC MTBAP Marine TurtleDatabase_KEEP
Users copy the appropriate file to their local computers and work from there
What each file does
TDPS_DataCorrections.accdb: Allows entry and edits to the Turtle database
TDPS_EnterData.accdb: Only for data entry. Meant to be used by less experienced people
TDPS_Queries.accdb: People can run their own queries on turtle data using the Google Gem made for that purpose. Queries can be saved and reused
TDPS_Tablet.accdb: Simplified tablet data entry used in the field on tablets
TDPS_DataCorrections - Japan: A version made for Japan to see if they can use it
LOTUS.accdb: To access the LOTUS database run by PIRO.
Setup-And-Run.ps1: Script that allows the import of the Google Sheets stranding data. This data is now managed by PIRO. So script is not used anymore
Back-end is at \\picqueenfish_VikramOnly.accdb
